recognize_zh: 抹片中數個小至中型、幾乎沒有細胞質的圓形芽細胞，核染色質均勻細緻、無顆粒，背景紅血球有明顯的水分乾燥假影（折光小泡），符合前 B 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Small-to-medium round blasts, about 1.5 times RBC diameter
Extremely high N:C ratio with barely visible cytoplasm
Round to oval nuclei with finely stippled, homogeneous chromatin
Nucleoli inconspicuous; no granules or Auer rods
Background RBCs show refractile water/drying artifact; one smaller cell with denser chromatin at top right
describe_en: Smear shows several small-to-medium sized blasts with an extremely high N:C ratio and scant, agranular cytoplasm. The nuclei are round to oval with finely stippled homogeneous chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. No Auer rods are identified. Surrounding red cells show prominent refractile water (drying) artifact, which should not be mistaken for inclusions. Findings are consistent with lymphoblasts of precursor B-lymphoblastic leukemia, with lineage confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Mature lymphocytes have coarse clumped chromatin, whereas these blasts have fine homogeneous chromatin.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML blasts are usually larger with more cytoplasm and nucleoli and are negative for CD19/CD10/TdT-B pattern while expressing CD13/CD33/CD117.
Morphologically identical; cytoplasmic CD3 expression and lack of CD19/CD79a define T lineage.
